name: Ikai no Yadochou
source:
Run an inn in the Otherworld, where forgotten things become tsukumogami. By day, tend to guests burdened by Kegare. By night, survive the horrors born from the impurity left behind. Your choices shape the guests’ healing and the inn’s fate.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4249520/%E7%95%B0%E7%95%8C%E3%83%8E%E5%AE%BF%E5%B8%B3/]Steam[/url]]
